relations.name: active_users
relations.viewDefinition:
SELECT username,
    data,
    age_range,
    status,
    catchphrase
   FROM public.users
  WHERE (status = 'ONLINE'::public.user_status);

relations.name: recent_messages
relations.viewDefinition:
SELECT id,
    data,
    message,
    username,
    channel_id
   FROM public.messages
  ORDER BY id DESC
 LIMIT 100;

user_status_counts
relations.viewDefinition:

    (count(*))::integer AS total
   FROM public.users
  GROUP BY status;
